description: Policy questions with the facts a correct answer must state. Five are answered only by a table row (t), the format that breaks naive text extraction.
provenance: the 18 retrieval golden questions, with expected facts taken from kb/seed

cases.query: Can I return a pack of rice after opening it?
cases.expected: No, not for a change of mind; only if defective (reported within 7 days with a photo and batch number).

cases.query: my bananas came bruised, what can I do
cases.expected: Report it in the app within 48 hours with one photo; no need to return the produce.

cases.query: How long do I have to return shampoo?
cases.expected: 7 days from delivery, unused and in original packaging.
No, frozen food and ice cream are not returnable once accepted (damage reported at the door only).

cases.query: Until when can I cancel my order for free?
cases.expected: While its status is Created, i.e. before packing starts.

cases.query: Is there a fee if I refuse a delivery?
cases.expected: Refused deliveries are refunded minus a ₹30 restocking fee for orders containing chilled or frozen items.

cases.query: Can I remove one item from an order I already placed?
cases.expected: No; cancel the whole order while it is Created and place a new one.
₹49, delivered within 30 minutes between 7 am and 10 pm.

cases.query: What is the minimum order for free standard delivery?
What happens if I am not home when the delivery arrives?
cases.expected: The partner waits 10 minutes and calls twice; one free reattempt in the next standard slot; if that fails too, cancelled and refunded minus the delivery fee.

cases.query: My express order was 20 minutes late. Do I get anything?
cases.expected: Yes, the express fee is refunded as store credit within 24 hours (it was more than 15 minutes late).

cases.query: How long does a card refund take?
Money was deducted but the order failed. What now?
cases.expected: Nothing to do; the bank reverses it automatically within 5 business days; contact support after 7 business days.

cases.query: Is cash on delivery available for big orders?
How many days of shelf life should paneer have when delivered?

cases.expected: Yes, by farms certified under NPOP (National Programme for Organic Production); certificate number on the product page.

cases.query: How many units can I buy in a flash sale?
cases.expected: At most 2 units per customer per flash-sale product.

cases.query: What is the support phone number?
